edits.new:
| Contract version | v1, published to the contract registry (section 4, step 8) |
| Kit version and compatibility | Kit artefact coordinates and first version: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2023). Published as a versioned library in the service template with a compatibility table per minor version. A worker build fails when it carries a kit minor the platform team has not released |
| Child workflow handle | The calling workflow holds the child handle and passes caseId, step and run number. P10 (rwb-agent) owns the AgentRunWorkflow type, its queue and its history (GAP-0073) |
| Quartz replacement | Temporal Schedules and durable timers of this kit replace the Quartz scheduler (RWB-TE-007). Every dependency on RWB-TE-007 points to this story (GAP-0154) |
| Intake Schedule ID | Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2337) |
